instruction: Proofread the document. Fix the known spelling, grammar, punctuation, word-choice, and style mistakes while preserving meaning, tone, paragraph ids, and intentional wording everywhere else.

issues.description: Introduces a lexical collocation error by replacing the idiomatic phrase "out of his way" with the unnatural combination "out of his road."

expectedCorrection.find: He even went out of his road to bully Buck
expectedCorrection.replace: He even went out of his way to bully Buck

issues.description: Omit one letter from a content word to create a realistic spelling error.

expectedCorrection.find: crying with sheer rage and eagernes as he
expectedCorrection.replace: crying with sheer rage and eagerness as he

issues.description: Introduce a realistic fat-finger typo by replacing an initial letter with an adjacent keyboard key in a long unique span.

expectedCorrection.find: The warm taste of it in his mouth hoaded him
expectedCorrection.replace: The warm taste of it in his mouth goaded him

issues.description: Introduces a comma splice by incorrectly joining two independent clauses with a comma.

expectedCorrection.find: Buck shook himself free, it was only for a moment.
expectedCorrection.replace: Buck shook himself free. But it was only for a moment.

issues.description: Omit the article in a noun phrase to create an article/determiner error.

expectedCorrection.find: Dub was badly injured in hind leg; Dolly, the
expectedCorrection.replace: Dub was badly injured in a hind leg; Dolly, the

issues.description: Omit the required verb "was" from a longer unique span to create a clear missing-word grammatical error.

expectedCorrection.find: But a cold snap on, the thermometer registering
expectedCorrection.replace: But a cold snap was on, the thermometer registering

issues.description: Introduce an incorrect verb inflection by changing the past-tense verb to its base form within a long unique anchor span.

expectedCorrection.find: By the time they make the Hootalinqua and good ice,
expectedCorrection.replace: By the time they made the Hootalinqua and good ice,

issues.description: Omit the required conjunction 'that' in a unique span near the end of the paragraph.

expectedCorrection.find: putting all his faith in François would save him
expectedCorrection.replace: putting all his faith in that François would save him

issues.description: Replace a correctly chosen noun with a visually similar but incorrect valid word.

expectedCorrection.find: whipping as yet administered to any of the teems.
expectedCorrection.replace: whipping as yet administered to any of the teams.

issues.description: Introduce a transposed-letter misspelling that turns one word into a nonword within a long unique span.

expectedCorrection.find: the club of the man in the red sweaetr had knocked
expectedCorrection.replace: the club of the man in the red sweater had knocked

issues.description: Introduce a real-word spelling error by replacing one correctly spelled word with a different valid word.

expectedCorrection.find: incomprehensible pride of the trial and trace—that pride
expectedCorrection.replace: incomprehensible pride of the trail and trace—that pride

issues.description: Introduce a pronoun agreement error by changing the singular object pronoun referring to Pike to a plural pronoun.

expectedCorrection.find: François called him and sought them in vain.
expectedCorrection.replace: François called him and sought him in vain.

issues.description: Introduced a sentence boundary error by replacing the period between two sentences with a comma, incorrectly merging them.

expectedCorrection.find: flew, with equal rage, in between, so unexpected was it,
expectedCorrection.replace: flew, with equal rage, in between. So unexpected was it,

issues.description: Remove the sentence break between two independent clauses, creating a run-on sentence.

expectedCorrection.find: Things no longer went right there was continual bickering
expectedCorrection.replace: Things no longer went right. There was continual bickering

issues.description: Introduce a homophone confusion by replacing the locative adverb with its same-sounding verb form.

expectedCorrection.find: Hear were many men, and countless dogs, and Buck found
expectedCorrection.replace: Here were many men, and countless dogs, and Buck found

issues.description: Replace the object pronoun with a subject-form pronoun, creating a pronoun case error.

expectedCorrection.find: Several things favored he in this. The week's rest
expectedCorrection.replace: Several things favored him in this. The week's rest

issues.description: Introduce a hyphenation error by incorrectly splitting the compound adjective in a longer unique span.

expectedCorrection.find: the good-natured, was less good natured, and whined
expectedCorrection.replace: the good-natured, was less good-natured, and whined

issues.description: Omit one letter from a content word to create a realistic spelling error.

expectedCorrection.find: it was a greater deligt slyly to precipitate a fight
expectedCorrection.replace: it was a greater delight slyly to precipitate a fight

issues.description: Insert an extra letter into a content word to create a realistic spelling error.

expectedCorrection.find: At the mouth of the Tahkeena, one night after suppper,
expectedCorrection.replace: At the mouth of the Tahkeena, one night after supper,

issues.description: Introduce a real-word spelling error by replacing the contextually correct noun with a different valid word.

expectedCorrection.find: to forest and plane to kill things by chemically
expectedCorrection.replace: to forest and plain to kill things by chemically

issues.description: Introduced an accidental duplicated word within a long unique span.

expectedCorrection.find: one is most alive, and and it comes as a complete
expectedCorrection.replace: one is most alive, and it comes as a complete

issues.description: Omit the period between two independent sentences, creating a clear sentence-boundary punctuation error.

expectedCorrection.find: It was Spitz The rabbit could not turn, and
expectedCorrection.replace: It was Spitz. The rabbit could not turn, and

issues.description: Lowercase the proper noun "Spitz" within a longer contextual span, creating an incorrect capitalization error.

expectedCorrection.find: drove in upon spitz, shoulder to shoulder, so hard
expectedCorrection.replace: drove in upon Spitz, shoulder to shoulder, so hard

issues.description: Introduce a single realistic keyboard slip by replacing one word with an adjacent-key typo.

expectedCorrection.find: suddenly drawing back his head and curvung in from the side
expectedCorrection.replace: suddenly drawing back his head and curving in from the side

issues.description: Omit the auxiliary verb "was" from a progressive verb phrase to create a clear auxiliary_or_modal_error.

expectedCorrection.find: while Buck streaming with blood and panting hard.
expectedCorrection.replace: while Buck was streaming with blood and panting hard.

issues.description: Introduces a tense mismatch by changing the past-tense verb to present tense within an otherwise past narrative.

expectedCorrection.find: this time he is the one who was beaten
expectedCorrection.replace: this time he was the one who was beaten
